about_the_game:
One day, I went to the rooftop of a building as if possessed.. There was a purple person standing alone there.. He said he was the combo master, but when the door closed, he said I had to learn all my combo skills to get out of here... What are you going to do?

This game is an extreme control game that requires both your left and right hands to move well at the same time.

The reason you can't change the key layout is because of the game's difficulty. Please consider this as part of the game.

Each stage has a target combo number. When you reach that number, you can advance to the next stage! When you reach the target combo until the last stage, the record mode will be activated and you will be recognized as a combo master!

Gameplay:

  • Movement is done by using the left and right keys only.

  • Skills are unlocked at each stage. Skills are Z>A>S>X>Q>W>E>D>C>V>F>R. You can reach Combo Master by clearing a total of 12 stages.

  • Skill key layout cannot be changed and is part of the game, including the game difficulty.

  • The game is automatically saved on each stage when it is cleared.

  • The final record shows the total game time and the highest combo saved on the last stage.

When you clear all stages, a record mode will be activated that will allow you to update your highest combo.

sound and background

  • Includes tense background music.

  • Includes dark atmospheric city background and building rooftop background.

  • There are hit effects and rain background effects.
